verdict.rationale: Archived docs once described a typed TypeScript SDK generated per published server and a Vercel AI SDK integration. Smithery's own shutdown notice says "The Smithery CLI and SDKs" stopped working on October 31, 2026, with those versions marked deprecated and the docs tree removed. No working official SDK remains to build against; only the CLI continues under the acquirer's org.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
